name: smwsprites-yi-chomp-rock
title: YI Chomp Rock
description:
The Chomp Rock from Yoshi's Island. Mario can walk up to it and push it to start rolling it. It will kill sprites in its way and can be used as a stepping stone.

This version is not dynamic and has a more choppy animation. It consumes the entirety of SP4.

Check the ASM file for customization options.
